nodes.title: Authority inventory and non-duplication lock
nodes.acceptance_gate: Inspect exact branch heads, commit/tree/blob SHA and per-source claims; identify previously PASS nodes and stale 2026-10-04 pending records
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: No re-run of F08/SYNC02/SYNC03 or completed atomic precision work; report unknown refs rather than infer
nodes.notes: Reuse 2026-10-04 GLOBAL_DAG/PR_PLAN as historic requirements; new DAG is a successor overlay.

nodes.title: Publish retained scientific diagnostics without recomputation
nodes.acceptance_gate: Reproduce figures from saved curves and finite-cell tau, label synthetic/conditional and source/observer tail limitations; numerical checks refer to retained receipts
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: No claim of physical EoR, continuum sign or sky anisotropy; no fresh full science rerun

nodes.title: Physical-input archives: exact intake and admission
nodes.acceptance_gate: Cross-check each file SHA/internal manifests against N2 missing fields: Bianchi background/epoch, hydrogen/helium initial abundances and temperature, spectrum/source history, closures and executable callback
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: If any mandatory field is null or only synthetic, mark PHYSICAL_HOLD with exact missing fields; do not fabricate values

nodes.title: Atomic process and opacity ownership registry
nodes.acceptance_gate: Distinct HI/HeI/HeII cross sections and binding cutoffs; case A explicit recombination photons XOR case B OTS; local HI absorption XOR effective MFP overlap; proper/comoving, photon/energy, frame and units verified
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: Fail on double-counting, unknown/unsupported rates, missing heating, incompatible source domains, HE excited-state differential spectrum misuse
nodes.notes: CR baseline photoabsorption/photoheating reuse is distinct from optional hard-particle deposition. Already integrated photon bins carry no extra 4pi/dE/a^-3/dt. Distinguish cm^-3/erg/H from SI native packet units.

nodes.title: Physical EoR scenario freeze (FLRW and Bianchi pair)
nodes.acceptance_gate: One identified, source-backed cosmological initial epoch and background (aV, directional shear), consistent H/He IC, T, source spectrum including explicit He-ionization claim support or narrowed claim, emissivity/escape/clumping assumptions with provenance
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: No post-hoc tuning of source, normalization, shear, IC or closure after inspecting pair; no claims from S0 13.7 eV fixture

nodes.title: Reuse primary microstep on first FLRW physical interval
nodes.acceptance_gate: Use existing coupled_primary/microstep; same-event photons and ions, nuclei/charge/energy, positivity, owner checks, independent check at fixed physical inputs
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: Fail-closed on missing data, case/opacity mismatch, precision/unit errors; do not reimplement solver

nodes.title: Reuse Bianchi-I geodesic/energy remap and angular cells
nodes.acceptance_gate: Exact directional characteristic energy relation, photon number and frequency-face flux telescoping, FLRW sigma->0 limit, frame conventions and KMS not assumed
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: Do not claim microphysical coupling, new history or physical result from collisionless transport tests

nodes.title: First physical Bianchi-I coupled interval
nodes.acceptance_gate: Same source/history/IC and frozen rates as FLRW, couple actual angular RT to same-event absorption/HHe chemistry/thermal power; energy and group-boundary ledgers closed
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: Fail on nonconvergence, conservation breach, missing time carry or source/opacity owner conflict; no prediction from a manufactured fixture

nodes.title: Source-backed multi-epoch FLRW EoR history
nodes.acceptance_gate: Evolve selected source-backed history over declared reionization epoch, species fractions/temperature/photons, causal photon inventory, post-overlap sink handling, independent FLRW reference/limit
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: No QV=xHII relabeling, no cosmological extrapolation beyond provider/source domain

nodes.title: Matched Bianchi-I/FLRW EoR history
nodes.acceptance_gate: Same cosmological source and closure, directional photon remap, time/angle/energy refinements, explicit shears; separation of background/history vs shear transport effect
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: Do not interpret numerical contrast as observationally novel if source/closure systematic larger or unconstrained

nodes.title: CMB receiver optical depth and visibility
nodes.acceptance_gate: Bind proper ne(t) from genuine physical paired history into existing BASS time/visibility API; observer-tail explicit; FLRW and non-tilted limits checked
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: No arbitrary tail=0 as physical total tau; do not imply full polarized CMB sky result

nodes.title: Scientific plot and observational-claim screening
nodes.acceptance_gate: Source-backed xHII,xHeII,xHeIII,Tg,Gamma,photons, delta observables, tau/visibility; uncertainties split numeric, atomic, source, geometry, spatial closure
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: Publication gate fails for unconstrained cosmological input, unmatched source, missing uncertainty or false QV claim

nodes.title: HE precision sensitivity import, when material
nodes.acceptance_gate: Only if process and temperature/source domain relevant; consume rates, event moments or bounded perturbations with provider authority; run matched ON/OFF sensitivity in rei once
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: Do not promote E13C10 finite interval width to physical model error; no 2440-path replay without need

nodes.title: CR hard-particle process extension, when material
nodes.acceptance_gate: Only if deposition/hard particle/temperature observables require, with native rate owner and supported point outputs
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: CR OFF remains legitimate baseline; full wide propagated numerical certificate OPEN
nodes.notes: Matched-history sensitivity stays after baseline figures; relevance and native source/domain binding happen earlier. S15 alone is not evidence for a native hard-particle provider.

nodes.title: HH chemistry/spectral response, when material
nodes.acceptance_gate: Bind named HH processes to stoichiometric network, threshold heating, domain; local sensitivity first, actual matched histories only if needed
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: Singlet ion-pair not replaced by free-electron LCS; native root/continuum unfinished; no ungrounded HH promotion

nodes.title: Patchiness/spatial topology extension
nodes.acceptance_gate: Declare density–ionization correlation, topology and spatial RT/IGM opacity source if QV, 21cm power or spatial sky inference claimed
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: Homogeneous xHII alone cannot be relabeled QV nor predict patchy 21cm spectrum

nodes.title: Physical promotion and reproducible release
nodes.acceptance_gate: Numerical convergence; source/model errors and physical assumptions; independent trusted checks, source/license/provenance, passed observable gate; actual repo commit and checksum receipts if published
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: Keep physical/continuum/production HOLD until own acceptance; optional precision/spatial results may remain open

nodes.title: Select CR process relevance before scenario freeze
nodes.acceptance_gate: Record selected source and process owners. CR_OFF_SCOPED is allowed; CR_ON records required energy/time/bath processes before the physical scenario is frozen.
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: A required unmodelled process narrows/holds that physical scenario; unknown source is not zero. A packet at a single bath knot does not admit a whole history.

nodes.title: Bind selected hard-particle source and native/cascade domain
nodes.acceptance_gate: Bind proton/electron spectral and time-basis identity, normalization, gas state, energy channels, existing operator/kernel scope and a heating/observable error budget. Existing PHYS01/03 packet is reused only at its admitted knots.
nodes.fail_closed_or_stop: Shared injection lineage does not permit multiplication of FS10 terminal heat by M0 p. Do not fabricate a consumer history, interpolate xi without an admitted model, or rerun atomic precision by default.
nodes.activation: Selected scenario enables CR or explicitly requests a standalone CR application

execution_policy.local_first: Light derivations, source/ABI/units/owner audit, analytic and saved-result tests are local
execution_policy.NCP: Only demonstrably heavy outstanding independent histories parameter sweep, source-validated spatial RT or expensive bounded error; do not dispatch idle 64-core tasks
no_new_heavy_until: measured wall/CPU/RSS or justified heavy scaling
execution_policy.mutation: This overlay is published only within bass_cr; downstream adoption/execution belongs to the named receiver owner
execution_policy.heavy_scope: Original no_new_heavy_until applies to coupled EoR execution. Explicit independent CR science/performance work retains its separate original contract and budgets.

supplied_evidence_boundary: Paths and documents inspected; archive payloads for P01/P02/P03/v2 not unpacked/admitted in this run; no scientific code/tests executed
scheduling: Use dependency readiness, including required_if for the selected claim. main_nodes is membership, not a serial queue or measured critical path.
